newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank repo average yield falls to 18.82 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank repo average yield falls to 18.82 pct.

text.p: The average yield at a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Monday fell to 18.82 percent from 19.83 percent on Friday, the central bank (NBS) said.
The NBS offered a maximum amount of 7.0 billion crowns. Overall bids totalled 11.228 billion crowns. The minimum accepted yield was 17.60 percent with the maximum yield hitting 20.40 percent.
The NBS added 1.0 billion crowns through a three-day repo tender on Friday, with the average yield rising to 19.83 percent from 19.50 percent on Thursday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 20 lacked 3.40 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
